outcome: Success rate of neuraxial techniques for postpartum tubal ligation (PPTL)
cohort: Patients undergoing PPTL after vaginal delivery (n=93)
finding: The success rate of postpartum epidural reactivation for tubal ligation was lower than previously reported, and patient height, epidural volume of local anesthetic, and administered fentanyl dose were lower in the group that failed reactivation.
